policy: Rules are mechanism-generic and declared before Batch 008 writes any candidate outcome class into the promotion audit. They do not use case-specific numeric thresholds and do not transform qualitative expectations into confidence scores.

cases.rationale: Congestion/backlog and freight-pressure mechanisms were observed in the expected direction, but the hypothesis did not contain a numeric success target and freight-market attribution was not cleanly isolated from the wider disrupted market.

The corridor restored large physical export flows and food-price indicators moved in the direction consistent with reduced logistics pressure, but FAO identified multiple contributing market/seasonal factors and the hypothesis lacked a numeric success target.

The terminal operated materially and supplied measurable gas volumes in the expected direction, but 'high utilization' and supply-security contribution were not defined as a numeric success threshold and system-level security attribution is multi-factor.
